profile.name: Jiangyu Liu
profile.subtitle: Undergraduate, Department of Automation, Tsinghua University

aboutMe: I am an undergraduate in the Department of Automation at Tsinghua University, currently working in Ning Ding's research group.

I am especially interested in using agents to control robots: how they can understand tasks, plan actions, and interact with the physical world. I am also interested in reinforcement learning (RL), world models, and 3D vision, and how these approaches can help robots perceive their surroundings, anticipate changes, and learn to accomplish tasks through interaction.

I am still at the beginning of my research journey and enjoy exploring new questions through learning and hands-on work. Outside research, I enjoy table tennis and volunteering. Feel free to reach out for a game, a meal, or a chat about research and volunteer activities!
campusExperienceLines: Selected coursework: Principles of Artificial Intelligence; Signals and Systems

Campus roles: Head of the Social Practice and Volunteering Group, Department of Automation; class president of the department's Tongban class; member of the Hardware Division of the department's Student Association for Science and Technology

items.title: Anyverse Dynamics | Algorithm Intern (Mar–Jun 2026)
items.text: Reproduced LoRA fine-tuning for π0 and inference pipelines for Fast-WAM and Motus. Profiled world action models to identify key computational paths and performance bottlenecks.

items.title: DISCOVER Robotics | Foundation Model Intern (Jun–Sep 2026)
items.text: Conducted training and evaluation experiments for world action models augmented with motion representations, investigating ZipMo motion tokens and an auxiliary motion prediction loss in Fast-WAM. Also conducted stereo video VAE experiments on RGB reconstruction and disparity prediction, including training and small-dataset overfitting checks.

items.title: Student Research Training (SRT)
items.text: Contributed to a robotic system for multimodal collaborative perception and concurrent task execution. Gained experience with robot system operation and the research process from initial design to deployment on physical robots.

items.title: ATEC 2026
items.text: Contributed to robot visual recognition and navigation, including functional debugging and simulation validation.
